constants.pp_no_notation:
Prop := ∀ (M : LifoBackpressure.Statements.NetworkModel) (η L : Real),
  M.HasSlackness η →
    LT.lt 0 L →
      Exists fun D =>
        Exists fun K =>
          Exists fun cstar =>
            And (LT.lt 0 D)
              (And (LT.lt 0 K)
                (And (LT.lt 0 cstar)
                  (∀ (V : Real),
                    LE.le 1 V →
                      ∀ (γstar : Fin M.r → Real),
                        M.IsUniqueDualOpt V γstar →
                          M.DualPolyhedral V γstar L →
                            ∀ (Ω : Type) [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
                              [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (proc : M.MarkovProcess Ω μ)
                              (pol : M.Policy proc),
                              LifoBackpressure.Statements.NetworkModel.Policy.FollowsBackpressure V pol →
                                ∀ (j : Fin M.r) (ι : Type)
                                  (Q : LifoBackpressure.Statements.LifoQueueRealization pol j ι) (lamJ lamTilde : Real),
                                  LT.lt 0 lamJ →
                                    Filter.Eventually
                                        (fun ω =>
                                          Filter.Tendsto
                                            (fun t =>
                                              HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑t)
                                                ((Finset.range t).sum fun τ => M.arrival (proc.S τ ω) (pol.act τ ω) j))
                                            Filter.atTop (nhds lamJ))
                                        (MeasureTheory.ae μ) →
                                      Filter.Eventually
                                          (fun ω =>
                                            Filter.Tendsto
                                              (fun t =>
                                                HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑t)
                                                  ((Finset.range t).sum fun τ =>
                                                    ite
                                                      (Membership.mem
                                                        (LifoBackpressure.Statements.backlogWindow (γstar j) D K V)
                                                        (pol.queue τ ω j))
                                                      (M.arrival (proc.S τ ω) (pol.act τ ω) j) 0))
                                              Filter.atTop (nhds lamTilde))
                                          (MeasureTheory.ae μ) →
                                        And
                                          (Filter.Eventually
                                            (fun ω =>
                                              Filter.Tendsto
                                                (fun t => HDiv.hDiv ↑(Q.windowDepartingArrivals (γstar j) D K V ω t) ↑t)
                                                Filter.atTop (nhds lamTilde))
                                            (MeasureTheory.ae μ))
                                          (And
                                            (LE.le
                                              (max
                                                (HSub.hSub lamJ
                                                  (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul M.δmax cstar) (HPow.hPow V (Real.log V))))
                                                0)
                                              lamTilde)
                                            (And (LE.le lamTilde lamJ)
                                              (LT.lt 0 lamTilde →
                                                Filter.Eventually
                                                  (fun ω =>
                                                    LE.le
                                                      (Filter.limsup
                                                        (fun t =>
                                                          ↑((Q.windowBufferSystem (γstar j) D K V ω).avgDelay t))
                                                        Filter.atTop)
                                                      ↑(HDiv.hDiv
                                                          (HAdd.hAdd
                                                            (HAdd.hAdd
                                                              (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 D)
                                                                (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul 2 K) (HPow.hPow (Real.log V) 2)))
                                                              (HMul.hMul 2 M.δmax))
                                                            1)
                                                          lamTilde))
                                                  (MeasureTheory.ae μ)))))))
